purpose: Assess whether self-verification tests demonstrate genuine negative-path detection or only structural assertions.

structural_assertions.what_it_proves: ControlPlane class exists and is importable
structural_assertions.what_it_does_not_prove: That duplicate authority injection would be detected
That a 10th command cannot bypass the control plane

structural_assertions.what_it_proves: Known legacy commands exist in migration_map
structural_assertions.what_it_does_not_prove: That an unknown bypass attempt would be rejected at runtime

behavioral_tests.what_it_proves: reconcile_obligations correctly computes incomplete when no records
Cache replay returns reusable=False for different commit

phase_10_self_verification_audit.verdict: PARTIAL — structural self-tests prove architecture shape but do not inject real violations and verify detection fires. The Phase 10 suite demonstrates that the architecture HAS detection mechanisms (migration_map, cache validation, obligation reconciliation) but does not prove those mechanisms actually catch injected violations.

remediation_path_for_genuine_negative_de.action: Inject a duplicate ControlPlane subclass and assert classification_for() flags it
remediation_path_for_genuine_negative_de.feasibility: HIGH — requires monkey-patching in test isolation

remediation_path_for_genuine_negative_de.action: Corrupt a cache entry and assert replay returns reusable=False with explicit reason
remediation_path_for_genuine_negative_de.feasibility: HIGH — already proven by Phase 5 gate tests

remediation_path_for_genuine_negative_de.action: Inject an unknown verification kind and assert adapter produces not_executable_yet
remediation_path_for_genuine_negative_de.feasibility: MEDIUM — requires test to create a PlannedTask with unknown kind
